_status: 2026-11-14. Parameters of src/planning (motion plans on the four-bar gripper model). Independent of the console path (src/tasks/console_grasp.py); nothing here has run on the arm. See docs/atlas-200i-dk-a2/29-夹爪四连杆与抓取解算.md.
_table_z_model_note: The table in the forward-kinematics frame as seen by the mesh fingers: the five fingertip touches of teleop session 20260925_005756_78eb (J6 168, gap 10 mm) put the lowest finger point at -0.97/-0.89/-0.89/-0.67/-0.92 cm, mean -0.87 +- 0.12 cm (gripper_geometry.table_from_touches). keep_out.table_surface_z_m = -1.42 cm is the same touches read with the 12 cm FK tip, which is 5.5-6 mm beyond the real closed fingertip. The scan registration of 2026-09-29 read the paper at -0.62 cm.

grasp._pad_centre_note: middle of the pads above the table when they close on a 3 cm block. The verified console grasp (FK tip 1.2 cm above the -1.42 table, +1 cm radially) closes them at ~2.5 cm above this table, i.e. on the block's top centimetre; 1.8 cm puts them around its middle. Not tried on the arm.
grasp._pad_lifts_note: a rolled jaw tilts out of the table plane and one finger hangs lower: the pads may close this much higher, while their middle stays pad_below_top_m under the block's top
grasp._openings_note: J6 commands tried widest first: 61 mm (console 'open'), 50 mm and 42 mm. The narrower ones keep the open fingers off neighbours closer than ~5 cm; they leave 10 / 6 mm of localization error per side. The console has no 'narrow'/'tight' action yet.

release._tilt_note: a block gripped at pitch p tilts with any J5 roll at another pitch or bearing; set down on the table it must be near level, dropped into a bin it only has to fit the 80 mm opening. yaw None keeps the J5 it was carried at.

margins._note: neighbour: open fingers to any other box; target: the block being gripped, while the fingers open/close around it; path_table: lowest gripper point on a transit; platform_mesh: link5 mesh points to config/platform_model.json (on top of the fitted workspace.py keep-out)

joint_limits_deg._note: J1/J2: arm_limits soft limits. J3/J4 down to -3: the floor the console grasps have used since 2026-09-26 (J4 reads back -2..-3 when -5..-8 is asked). J5 90-180: above 180 the gripper servo turns up into the wrist camera's view (operator 2026-09-26); below 90 is outside the course limit.

roll._note: arm_limits gripper.roll_zero_deg / roll_sign; J5 turns the real jaw opposite to dofbot_kinematics.servo5_pose (gripper_geometry.link5_pose)

path._note: over-the-top route: FK tip this far above the highest box at the start's and the goal's bearing; flatter pitches reach higher
